description: This Java class implements a custom OAuth2 authorization request resolver for handling OAuth2 login flows, including mobile app token validation, PKCE, and OpenID Connect nonce handling within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: CustomOAuth2AuthorizationRequestResolver
classes.description: A class that customizes OAuth2 authorization request resolution, including mobile app token validation, PKCE, and OpenID nonce handling.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves OAuth2 authorization request based on HttpServletRequest, extracting parameters and handling mobile app token validation.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves OAuth2 authorization request with a specific registrationId, defaulting to 'authorize' action.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves the action parameter from the request, defaulting if not present.

methods.name: getAppPackage
methods.description: Retrieves the 'pkg' parameter from the request.

methods.name: getPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves the 'platform' parameter from the request.

methods.name: getAppToken
methods.description: Retrieves the 'appToken' parameter from the request.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Builds OAuth2AuthorizationRequest with client registration, redirect URI, and additional parameters, including mobile app token validation.

methods.name: validateMobileAppToken
methods.description: Validates mobile app token and retrieves callback URL scheme.

methods.name: resolveRegistrationId
methods.description: Extracts registrationId from request URL if matching pattern.

methods.name: expandRedirectUri
methods.description: Generates redirect URI by expanding template with request and client registration info.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Constructs the redirect URI based on request scheme, domain, port, and configured login processing URL.

methods.name: needsPort
methods.description: Determines if port should be included in URL based on scheme and port number.

methods.name: addNonceParameters
methods.description: Generates and adds a nonce and its hash for OpenID Connect requests.

methods.name: addPkceParameters
methods.description: Generates PKCE code verifier and challenge, adding them to request parameters.

methods.name: createHash
methods.description: Creates SHA-256 hash of a string, used for nonce and PKCE challenge.
